title: Eddie Torres:
title_short: Reel · Eddie · Wait a Minute, Who Is This?
headline: His mother raised him alone and never got to know him. The work he did inside gave her a different son for the years she had left.
story: Eddie is the FTC program coordinator and an alumnus. This reel is not his prison story and not his first workshop. It is the phone calls with his mother after the work started. She heard a different voice and asked who it was. They built the relationship he always wanted in the years before she passed away. She died before he was released. His brothers and sisters now ask him where he got this from.

Loops: L1 “Who is she talking to?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:04 (“It starts with my mother”). L2 “Did she get to see the change?” opens 0:00 and closes in the BUTTON (“for so many years before she passed away … I know she's proud of me”). Stakes: she passed away before he got out. The years she had left were the only years they had.

Do not say or show what he was convicted of. Do not name any other staff or volunteer.
